descriptionChirho: To heap verbal abuse, insults, or taunts upon someone out of hostility or contempt; used of persecutors mocking believers or Christ (Matt 5:11, 27:44; Mark 15:32; Luke 6:22; Rom 15:3).
To censure sharply or reprimand with authority, expressing strong disapproval; used of Jesus rebuking the disciples for unbelief or of denouncing unrepentant cities (Matt 11:20; Mark 16:14).
To give generously without finding fault or casting blame; used specifically of God who gives wisdom without reproaching the asker (Jas 1:5).
